title: Thai Macaron Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-inspired dish made with crispy macaron-crusted chicken, kissed flaky French bread, and a variety of Thai spices. Serve with steamed vegetables for a well-rounded meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the crushed French bread and cook until crispy, about 2 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, French chili flakes, fish sauce, and garlic to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sugar and salt to the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro.
Enjoy with steamed vegetables for a well-rounded meal.
